HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   D. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   D. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
